_note: The decision point registry this example registers with the engine, as data. A decision requested at an unregistered point is refused as a conformance failure rather than evaluated against an assumed shape; resource_schema is the declared shape checked before evaluation, and cap-document-validation owns the real dialect. Five points, because five different actions of this run are decided in their own right: admitting the unit, the metered model call, firing the effect, applying a person's decision, and intervening on a stuck cell. Proposed: the five points are this example's design, not a recorded registry.

admission.entry.taken_at: admission, when a unit of work enters through any of the four doors

dispatch.model_call.taken_at: dispatch, before the metered completion of one attempt

dispatch.tool_call.taken_at: dispatch, before the effect fires - and again after a pause, because an allow is spent when its action fires or is abandoned

steer.decision.taken_at: the human boundary, before a person's decision is applied to the run

steer.intervention.taken_at: the operator boundary, before a machine-state lifecycle operation touches a stuck cell
